title: The wrapper's lifeline: the native child dies when the wrapper does, even by SIGKILL (DEC-282 (a2) item 2)
description: Carrier for DEC-282 (a2) item 2 (opum-doc ODOC-634), after the QCLI-567 wrapper PR. The wrapper holds the write end of a pipe and passes it to the native child; when the child reads EOF on it (wrapper died by any signal including SIGKILL, or the caller killed the caller group), the child kills its own group and exits. A pipe, not getppid()==1: portable and immediate, and macOS has no PDEATHSIG. Touches bin/quest.cjs (launcher class: sonnet-or-higher, opus security review, no DeepSeek) and the native binary, so the fence in dispatch-floor applies. If it does not land by the pair cut, the CHANGELOG states the residual (already written under Unreleased by the QCLI-567 PR) and it ships in the next patch release.

acceptanceCriteria.text: kill -9 on the wrapper leaves no surviving native or grandchild process
kill -9 on the caller group (killpg) leaves no surviving native or grandchild process
a normal run, including piped stdin and a TTY run, is unaffected
each proof goes red with the lifeline removed (both directions proven)
the CHANGELOG residual note is removed or updated to match what shipped

implementationNotes: OWED from the #750 review (QCLI-572), non-blocking, carried here because this task touches the same wrapper and test (leader ruling to save budget; no separate code PR): (1) per-clause witnesses for fd 1 and fd 2: add `: | node wrapper >/dev/null` (only stderr a terminal) and `: | node wrapper 2>/dev/null` (only stdout a terminal), since dropping only the fd-1 or only the fd-2 clause currently leaves both pty tests green. (2) a deterministic SIGUSR1 witness through the --require preload (wrap process.kill and write a marker when called with (process.pid, "SIGUSR1")), and correct the overclaiming test comment ("a slow inspector cannot keep a mutant green"; the timing race remains). (3) reword the F3 comment in bin/quest.cjs as inferred ("can retry"/"is believed to"): the glibc ENOEXEC-through-/bin/sh diagnosis was never read from a log. (4) delete the stale duplicate comment above hasScript in test/qcli567-wrapper-orphan.test.ts (the one now attached to ptyTest is the live one). QCLI-572 closes when its AC8 (the F4 witness) does.
